title: Dark's more advancements
description: This datapack adds a few advancements into your world.
body:
## Hello! 
Disclaimer: This datapack is currently in beta and made with MCreator because i'm bad in coding.

This datapack adds few advancements into your world. Here is all the advancements in that moment:
| Name                | Describtion           |
|---------------------|:---------------------:|
| First things first  | Craft your first pickaxe|
| If it looks edible, I can eat it | Eat rotten flesh |
| This one hurts      | Get damaged by Iron Golem (Well, his job is to protect village)|
| Graduated Survivalist | Get full set of netherite instruments, armor and totem of undying (including nautilus and horse armor, netherite block and netherite upgrade) |
